prompt: In PDB entry 5CJ6, show the whole structure as a white cartoon and the residues replaced by the AR (Androgen receptor) variants p.P724S and p.M781I (each pathogenic or likely pathogenic in ClinVar) as yellow ball-and-stick.

Method: X-RAY DIFFRACTION, 2.07 Å
Polymer chains (author chain [label chain]; observed residues as author numbering = label numbering):
  A [A]: entity 1 (Androgen receptor), protein, 244 of 283 residues observed: auth 671-844 = label 33-206; auth 849-918 = label 211-280

checks: target (2 residue(s), 15 atoms, residue name(s) MET/PRO = the wild type) is the same atom set by three routes on the frozen atom table: label numbering from the frozen variant file, author numbering as written in the MVS reference, and the frozen SIFTS lookup of the UniProt position

the task accepts the cartoon style (ligands, ions and water gone) and the default view (all drawn), so an answer may also set hide_water, hide_heteroatoms: with each, every accepted list still draws the target atoms as before (scripts/api_forms.py)
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 = 1, target score 1), and so does every accepted alternative
the twin on the other track selects the same target atoms
graded what the number in the variant's name selects when taken at face value as the author residue number (wrong) and as the label residue number (wrong); recorded under clinical.difficulty

clinical.api_note: pdbe-molstar resolves uniprot_accession + uniprot_residue_number itself (SIFTS), so this API task tests knowing that selector and supplying the accession; its MVS twin tests doing the UniProt-to-structure mapping.

provenance.derived: UniProt position of each variant from the frozen ClinVar-confirmed list; structure residues from the frozen SIFTS mapping
